problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=⟨-2,3⟩$ and $\text{v}=⟨4,-6⟩.$
worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 3 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 \\ 3 & -6\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-2)\cdot (-6)-4\cdot 3 \\  & =12-12 \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,0\,|=0
$$
